Write a figure at house resolution through a device that emits plain sRGB.

Source: R/plot_theme.R
bc_ggsave.Rd

R's default bitmap device on macOS (type = "quartz") bakes an Apple "Generic RGB" ICC profile into the PNG and converts the pixel values into it. LaTeX ignores the embedded profile and renders the raw values, so an Okabe-Ito orange (#E69F00) prints as #DE8E08 and the blue (#0072B2) as #0B5DA2 — darker, hue-shifted, and with the palette's contrast flattened. Pin an sRGB device so the written pixels are the colours we asked for.

Usage

bc_ggsave(filename, plot, width, height, dpi = 600, ...)

Arguments

filename

output path.

plot

a ggplot object.

width, height

size in inches.

dpi

resolution (house style: 600).

...

passed to ggplot2::ggsave().
